Package gnu.app.redbook

Class Pixel

java.lang.Object
gnu.app.Application
gnu.x11.Application
gnu.x11.extension.glx.Application
gnu.app.redbook.Pixel
public class Pixel extends Application
Draw a checkerbard image with pixel operations. To demonstrate GL.draw_pixels(int, int, int, int, gnu.x11.Data), GL.copy_pixels(int, int, int, int, int), and GL.pixel_zoom(float, float). move pointer while pressing BUTTON1.
  • To draw,
  • To increase zoom factor, press 'z'.
  • To decrease zoom factor, press 'Z'.
  • To reset, press 'r' or 'R'.
Modified from image.c.
